name: graph-first-navigation
body: The ordering discipline this change-set installs: for any fact about code or structure — declarations, dependencies, containment, enumeration, discovery — the program graph is consulted first, and file tools are confirmatory (open the graph's `path` at its `start_line`/`end_line`) or cover artifacts the graph does not model (build/packaging manifests and scripts). It dissolves the observed failure where an agent reached for glob/read/grep on source the graph already carried, because the prompt scoped graph-first to relationships and left discovery unstated.
